title: AlphaZero Tabula-Rasa Self-Play RL Masters Chess, Shogi & Go From Rules Alone
aiSystem: AlphaZero & AlphaGo Zero (Tabula-Rasa Self-Play RL + MCTS — Google DeepMind)
whyItMatters: Eliminated human training data and domain heuristics entirely: a single tabula-rasa self-play RL + MCTS algorithm mastered Chess, Shogi, and Go from rules alone in hours—directly spawning AlphaTensor, AlphaDev, MuZero, and AlphaProof.
summary: Published in Science in December 2018 (generalizing October 2017’s Nature AlphaGo Zero breakthrough, doi:10.1038/nature24270) by David Silver, Thomas Hubert, Julian Schrittwieser, Ioannis Antonoglou, Demis Hassabis, and colleagues at Google DeepMind, AlphaZero proved that a single general-purpose reinforcement learning algorithm—starting from completely random play with zero human games or domain-specific evaluation heuristics—could master three radically different grand-challenge games (Chess, Shogi, and Go) from basic rules alone. Within 4 to 24 hours of self-play, AlphaZero defeated world-champion specialized engines Stockfish (Chess), Elmo (Shogi), and AlphaGo Zero (Go) while searching ~1,000× fewer positions per second than Stockfish, directly creating the template for autonomous algorithmic and mathematical discovery.
technicalHighlights: Single unified neural-network + MCTS algorithm achieved superhuman mastery across Chess, Shogi, and Go starting purely tabula rasa from game rules.
Defeated Stockfish 8 in Chess (28 wins, 72 draws, 0 losses in 100 games) while evaluating ~60,000 positions/sec versus Stockfish’s ~60 million/sec.
Directly evolved into MuZero (learned world models), AlphaTensor (faster matrix multiplication), AlphaDev (faster assembly sorting), and AlphaProof (Lean theorem proving).
caveats: Requires an exact, fast simulator of deterministic, perfect-information environment rules (generalized to unknown dynamics by MuZero and to imperfect-information games by Pluribus/DeepNash).

scoreRationale.foundational: Proved general-purpose tabula-rasa self-play reinforcement learning + tree search can surpass centuries of accumulated human domain knowledge.
scoreRationale.ripple: Directly enabled AlphaTensor, AlphaDev, AlphaProof, MuZero, and modern test-time RL reasoning search across math and computer science.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Science (2018) and Nature (AlphaGo Zero, 2017) with decisive open-engine match validation against Stockfish and Elmo.
scoreRationale.velocity: Rebuilt and surpassed centuries of human chess and shogi theory from scratch in 4 to 24 hours of self-play.
